info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Logistics Shipments Etas-v3-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments ETA API provides users with timely estimated arrival times for shipments in the logistics network. This endpoint allows users to query and retrieve accurate ETAs for their shipments, enabling efficient planning and coordination. Typical consumers include logistics managers, supply chain coordinators, and platform integrations seeking to optimize delivery schedules. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance visibility into shipment statuses and improve customer satisfaction through reliable communication of delivery timelines.

get.summary: Retrieve Estimated Arrival Time for Shipments
get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain the estimated arrival time for their shipments. By providing the necessary parameters, users can get timely updates on when they can expect their shipments to arrive.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) for shipments. This body should contain the necessary parameters to calculate the ETA based on specific shipment details.

201.description: The shipment ETA has been successfully calculated.

ListLogisticsShipmentsEtasRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation to retrieve estimated time of arrival (ETA) for shipments. The request body is expected to be a simple string.
